title: cbuild_settings
description: The shop's settings, stored in the cbuild_settings option. What WooCommerce > Settings > Builder saves is checked against this.

attribute_mapping.description: Which product attribute feeds which spec, and the unit its values are written in.

attribute.description: A taxonomy such as pa_width, or the name of a product's own attribute.

spec.description: The spec key the attribute feeds.

unit.description: The unit an unmarked value is in, for a measure. Empty is the spec's own.

source_order.description: Which source wins where two say different things of one spec. First wins; each source once.

build_discount.description: The percentage taken off each part of a build, written with a point and up to two places. 0 is none; it is always below 100.

fixed_coupons.description: Where a fixed-product coupon that takes the kit lands: on the kit's line alone, or on every part as well.

rate_limit.description: How many times a minute one address may ask the state route.

trusted_proxy_header.description: The request header a proxy the shop trusts names the visitor's address in, such as X-Forwarded-For. Empty reads REMOTE_ADDR.

kit_defaults.description: What a new kit starts from.

schema_version.description: The document's version. Version 1 is the only one so far.

default_on.description: Whether a build starts with assembly on.

fee.description: The assembly fee in the shop's currency, as a decimal in text: 15 or 15.50. 0 is free.

lead_time.description: The lead time, in the owner's words.

returns_notice.description: The returns notice shown before checkout.

assembly.description: The assembly settings a new kit's Build tab starts from, as schema/kit-assembly.json has them.
